title: Pricing Experiments Metrics Dashboard — Draft Spec (2026 Q1)
content:
Owner: Chris Osei (Product Ops)
Last review: 2026-02-19
Status: Draft — for review by Product (Nikhil), Data Eng (Mei), Telemetry (Logan), Finance (Emily/Rishi), SRE/Obs (Allison)

Purpose
- Provide a single, consistent dashboard for evaluating pricing/packaging experiments (Hosted API primarily; Dedicated signals as available).
- Reduce time-to-readout and prevent metric drift across ad-hoc notebooks.
- Bake in measurement caveats (meter rounding, retries, streaming disconnects, caching/batching) so we don’t over-interpret experiment deltas.
- Add guardrails/alerts so we catch instrumentation breaks and customer-impacting anomalies early.

Non-goals (explicit)
- Not building a new experiment assignment system.
- Not replacing Finance’s invoice close controls (this should link to those checks; not duplicate them).
- Not a full self-serve BI platform; start opinionated with 10–15 canonical charts and drilldowns.

Audience / users
- Product: Nikhil Sharma, Evelyn Hart (decision-making; ship/iterate/stop)
- RevOps/Sales Ops: Isabelle Laurent (quoting guidance and CRM hygiene)
- Finance/FP&A: Rishi Malhotra, Emily Stone (margin, invoice risk, anomaly triage)
- Eng Telemetry: Logan Wright / Nadia Rahman (instrumentation validity)
- SRE/Observability: Allison Grant (alert routing, suppression during backfills)

Where this lives
- Primary: Looker (preferred) or Sigma (acceptable) backed by analytics warehouse tables
- Secondary exports: weekly PDF snapshot to shared drive; key charts pasted into Confluence readout

Data sources (must be declared on dashboard)
1) Experiment registry
- Source: Experiment catalog + assignment table
- Required fields:
  - experiment_id (string, stable)
  - experiment_name
  - owner (person/team)
  - start_at, end_at
  - status (active/paused/completed)
  - eligibility rules (self-serve vs enterprise; plan; region; model)
  - variants (control + treatments)

2) Assignment / exposure events (preferred)
- experiment_assignment event emitted when a customer/account becomes eligible and assigned
- Required properties:
  - experiment_id
  - variant_id
  - assignment_unit (account_id | workspace_id | org_id)
  - assigned_at (timestamp)
  - assignment_source (pricing-service | console | manual)
  - eligibility_snapshot (freeform string ok for v1; ideally structured later)

3) Usage + billing meters (Hosted API)
- Source of truth: billing-ready aggregates (post-telemetry aggregation; aligned to invoice mapping)
- Must be joinable to:
  - account_id / workspace_id
  - time (UTC day, invoice month)
  - model_id + model_family
  - region
  - endpoint_type (chat/completions/embeddings/rerank)
  - meter_version (so we can annotate known changes)

4) Revenue / monetization
- Source: invoice line items table (finalized) + billing-run staging tables (for near-real-time)
- Required fields:
  - invoice_month
  - invoice_run_id
  - line_item_type (hosted_tokens | hosted_embeddings | hosted_rerank | platform_fee | dedicated_commit | etc.)
  - amount_usd
  - currency
  - credits_applied_usd (free credits + one-time credits)
  - net_amount_usd

5) Customer lifecycle
- Source: accounts dimension + CRM (HubSpot) for segment metadata
- Required fields:
  - customer_tier (self_serve / growth / enterprise)
  - plan_name
  - industry (if available)
  - sales_owner (optional)
  - region_primary
  - created_at
  - first_paid_at
  - churn_at (if churned)


Core metric definitions (v1)
Note: Metric naming must match the dashboard labels exactly; definitions should be embedded in an “Info” panel.

A) Acquisition / conversion
1) Signups
- Definition: count of new workspaces created (workspace_created) in date range
- Segment: by experiment eligibility criteria (if possible)

2) Activation (Hosted API)
- Definition: workspace has >= 1 successful inference request within 7 days of signup
- Data: request_outcome dimension is required to avoid counting failures as activation

3) Paid conversion
- Definition: workspace transitions to paid plan OR first invoice posted (depends on self-serve vs contract)
- For self-serve: first successful charge OR first invoice non-zero net_amount_usd
- For enterprise: first invoice month with committed fee OR platform fee posted

4) Trial-to-paid conversion rate
- Numerator: paid conversions
- Denominator: eligible workspaces assigned to experiment (by assigned_at cohort)

B) Revenue & unit economics
5) Gross revenue (GR)
- Sum(amount_usd) from invoice line items for scoped products

6) Net revenue (NR)
- GR minus credits_applied_usd (free credits + goodwill credits)

7) Usage volume (core)
- input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens
- embeddings_units
- rerank_units
- requests
- Must support both: “billed usage” and “raw usage” where possible

8) Effective price per 1K tokens
- NR attributable to token line items / (billed_total_tokens / 1000)
- Caveat: only interpretable when token line items exist (not pure commit months)

9) Contribution margin proxy (Hosted API)
- (NR - estimated_COGS) / NR
- estimated_COGS initially approximated from GPU cost model table + token-to-GPU conversion assumptions
- Use Rishi’s sensitivity sheet as baseline; display as “proxy” with tooltip

C) Retention / expansion
10) GRR / NRR (cohort-based)
- Cohort: assigned_at month (or first_paid_at month)
- GRR: retained revenue / baseline revenue
- NRR: (retained + expansion - contraction) / baseline

11) Expansion rate
- % of accounts with >20% increase in NR or total_tokens month-over-month

12) Churn
- Logo churn: account churn flag
- Revenue churn: NR drops to ~0 for 2 consecutive invoice months

D) Experiment health / guardrails
13) Data completeness
- % of usage rows with required dims present (model_id, region, endpoint_type, request_outcome)

14) Dispute rate proxy
- Count of billing dispute tickets (Jira SUP*) tagged “metering” / # active paid accounts
- Optional v1 if we can join account_id to Jira tickets; if not, keep as manual annotation


Dashboard structure (proposed)

Page 1 — Executive summary (per experiment_id)
- Experiment status, start/end, owner, target segment, variants
- Headline KPI table:
  - Conversion lift vs control (with CI)
  - NRR delta (early proxy if immature)
  - GM proxy delta
  - Guardrail status (green/yellow/red)
- Notes panel:
  - Known measurement caveats (e.g., “streaming disconnect fix deployed 2026-02-xx; interpret pre-fix output tokens with caution”)

Page 2 — Funnel & conversion
- Time series: eligible → assigned → activated → paid
- Breakdown by:
  - customer_tier
  - region
  - workload_type (proxy via endpoint mix: chat-heavy vs embedding-heavy)

Page 3 — Usage & monetization
- Token volume and request volume trends by variant
- Net revenue trend by variant
- Credits applied (stacked) by variant
- Effective price / 1K tokens by model_family and region

Page 4 — Retention & expansion
- Cohort retention curves (90-day where available)
- NRR waterfall (baseline, expansion, contraction, churn)

Page 5 — Guardrails & anomalies
- Data completeness over time
- Spend spike detection
- “Mismatch indicators” (console vs invoice if we have both tables)
- Streaming/retry anomalies (see below)


Dimensions & filters (standardized)
All charts must share the same filter bar so screenshots are interpretable.

Required dashboard filters
- experiment_id (single select)
- date range (default: experiment start → today)
- variant_id (multi select)
- customer_tier
- plan_name
- region
- model_family
- endpoint_type

Standard dimensions (canonical values)
- model_family: llama, mistral, qwen, proprietary-redwood-verified (placeholder), other
- endpoint_type: chat, completions, embeddings, rerank
- request_outcome: success, client_cancel, timeout, server_error, rate_limited, other
- retry_reason: none, gateway_retry, client_retry, internal_failover, other
- caching_applied: true/false (if available)
- batching_bucket: small/medium/large (if available; proxy ok)

Notes on time zones
- Dashboard should default to UTC for consistency with billing aggregates.
- If we add “customer local time” views later, it must be clearly labeled and not used for invoice reconciliation.


Required event properties / instrumentation spec
This is the minimum needed to do experiment analysis without heroics.

1) experiment_assignment (new or formalized)
- owner: Product Platform (TBD) + Telemetry to ingest
- required:
  - event_name = experiment_assignment
  - experiment_id
  - variant_id
  - assignment_unit_type (workspace/account/org)
  - assignment_unit_id
  - assigned_at (event timestamp)
  - eligibility_reason (string; e.g., “self_serve_paid_plan=starter; region=us-east; created_after=2026-01-01”)

2) pricing_exposure (optional but nice)
- event fired when pricing/limits UI is shown (console) or quoting config retrieved (api)
- required:
  - experiment_id, variant_id
  - surface = console | api | sales_quote
  - exposure_at

3) request_metering_event (existing; ensure completeness)
- required dims (some may exist already; confirm):
  - account_id/workspace_id
  - model_id + model_family
  - region
  - endpoint_type
  - request_outcome
  - retry_reason
  - tokens_input, tokens_output, tokens_cached (where applicable)
  - streaming = true/false
  - client_disconnect = true/false (or equivalent)
  - meter_version

4) invoice_line_item
- required to join to experiments:
  - account_id/workspace_id
  - invoice_month
  - invoice_run_id
  - line_item_type
  - amount_usd
  - credits_applied_usd
  - meter_version (if feasible; otherwise join via date ranges)


Guardrail alerts (v1)
Alerts should route to #finance and SRE oncall (per ENG-4824 / dashboards PR) with links to the dashboard section + runbook.

A) Instrumentation / completeness
1) Missing dimension spike
- Trigger: % rows missing model_family OR region OR endpoint_type exceeds 0.5% for any day
- Severity: warning; page if >2% or persists 2+ days
- Owner: Logan (triage), Nadia (fix)

2) Assignment coverage drop
- Trigger: eligible accounts in experiment registry but no experiment_assignment events for >5% of them (rolling 7d)
- Owner: Chris (registry sanity) + Logan (events)

B) Billing risk indicators (not necessarily “experiment” issues but must be visible)
3) Spend spike per account
- Trigger: daily NR > (7d avg * 3) AND absolute increase > $500
- Suppress during known backfills (manual flag window)
- Owner: Allison (alert tuning) + Emily (finance triage)

4) Negative or zero usage with positive revenue (or vice versa)
- Trigger: invoice line items present but billed usage aggregates missing for same invoice_month
- Owner: Emily + Nadia

C) Streaming/retry anomalies
5) Output tokens billed after disconnect (proxy)
- Trigger: increase in output_tokens for request_outcome=client_cancel compared to baseline ratio
- Owner: Nadia + Cole (billing hooks)

6) Retry double-count indicator
- Trigger: billed_total_tokens / raw_total_tokens exceeds 1.02 for a region+endpoint bucket (tune threshold)
- Owner: Logan + Nadia


Statistical approach (what the dashboard should compute vs show)
- Dashboard should show point estimates and uncertainty where feasible.
- v1 compute options:
  - For conversion: two-proportion z-test or Wilson intervals per variant; show CI
  - For revenue: bootstrap confidence intervals (may be too heavy in BI); alternative: show distribution + annotate “directional”
- Decision: Keep heavy stats in notebook for now; dashboard shows:
  - lift = treatment - control
  - simple CI for conversion
  - sample sizes, exposure counts, and maturity indicators (“data is <14 days old”)

“Maturity” badges
- Show a banner if:
  - < N=200 assignments per variant
  - < 2 invoice cycles observed
  - Experiment overlaps known metering changes (meter_version change in range)


Known instrumentation gaps / open questions
(Please keep this section updated; it’s the main reason this doc exists.)

Gap 1 — experiment_assignment event not consistently emitted
- Current state: Some experiments inferred from config tables; console exposures not tracked
- Impact: selection bias / wrong denominators
- Owner: Chris (requirements) + Ethan/Cole (where assignment should live) + Logan (telemetry ingestion)
- Target: by end of Feb invoice cycle if possible

Gap 2 — request_outcome / retry_reason not fully plumbed through metering aggregates
- Current state: fields exist in raw logs for some services but not consistently in billing-ready aggregates
- Impact: can’t separate billed vs non-billed tokens cleanly; retries may inflate usage
- Owner: Nadia + Logan
- Related: linear ENG-4823, github pr_41917

Gap 3 — caching/batching signals not available in billing-ready tables
- Current state: runtime has caching; analytics doesn’t expose a stable per-request flag
- Impact: Hard to interpret unit economics deltas (esp. effective cost/token)
- Owner: Logan to propose minimal fields; Rishi to define what’s needed for GM proxy

Gap 4 — credits attribution by experiment variant
- Current state: credits applied at invoice level; unclear mapping to variant if account switches variants or if credits are global
- Impact: net revenue comparisons may be skewed
- Proposal: attribute credits at account-month level; if variant changes mid-month, show “mixed” badge or pro-rate by assignment days
- Owner: Mei (data model) + Chris (policy)

Gap 5 — Dedicated commit metrics not standardized
- Current state: commit burn-down exists in separate systems; not comparable to Hosted usage
- Impact: packaging experiments that touch Dedicated are hard to evaluate
- Owner: Isabelle (deal structures) + Emily (billing) to define minimal v1 fields

Gap 6 — Console vs invoice alignment (time zones, model aliases)
- Current state: known mismatch issues; being fixed in console alignment work
- Owner: Chloe (console) + Emily (validation)
- Related: linear ENG-4825, github pr_41941


Data model sketch (tables we expect)
No strict schema here, just naming so we can align on what exists vs what we’re asking for.
- dim_accounts (account_id, tier, plan, region_primary, created_at, first_paid_at, churn_at, …)
- fact_experiment_assignments (assignment_unit_id, experiment_id, variant_id, assigned_at, …)
- fact_usage_billing_agg_daily (date_utc, account_id, model_family, region, endpoint_type, request_outcome, retry_reason, billed_input_tokens, billed_output_tokens, embeddings_units, rerank_units, requests, meter_version, …)
- fact_invoice_line_items (invoice_month, invoice_run_id, account_id, line_item_type, amount_usd, credits_applied_usd, net_amount_usd, …)
- dim_models (model_id, model_family, alias_group, …)


Acceptance criteria (v1)
Functional
- For any experiment_id in the catalog, a dashboard page loads with:
  - assignment counts by variant
  - conversion funnel with denominators clearly labeled
  - usage and net revenue time series by variant
  - at least one retention proxy (if time exists)

Data quality
- All key charts show last_updated timestamp + source table name
- Dashboard includes a “Known caveats” callout automatically populated from a simple table keyed by date range + meter_version

Operational
- Guardrail alerts configured and tested (at least 2 weeks) with suppression mechanism for backfills
- Runbook link included in alert payload (billing discrepancy triage runbook)


Implementation plan (rough)
Week 1
- Align on metrics & dims (this doc) + confirm what tables exist
- Identify 3–5 active experiments to validate against (from catalog)

Week 2
- Build base Looker explores / Sigma datasets
- Implement executive summary + funnel pages

Week 3
- Add guardrails page + alert hooks
- Start data completeness tracking and assignment coverage checks

Week 4
- QA with Finance using sample invoices and known anomalies
- Publish internal link + office hours


Owners / next steps
- Chris Osei: finalize metric list; get sign-off from Nikhil + Emily; maintain experiment registry mapping
- Mei Lin: propose joins & modeling approach; document grain; implement credits attribution rule
- Sana Farid: recommend which statistical outputs are safe to compute in BI vs notebooks; define minimum sample size guidelines
- Logan Wright: confirm event availability and ingestion; propose minimal additional fields for caching/batching
- Allison Grant: align alerting thresholds + suppression rules; ensure links to runbook
- Isabelle Laurent: validate segmentation fields needed for Sales motion (plan, tier, region); ensure dashboard supports quoting questions


Appendix A — Metric caveats to display in tooltips (draft language)
- Tokens: “Token counts are measured at the API boundary; streaming responses may produce partial output tokens if a client disconnects. Billed tokens follow meter_version rules and may differ from console displays during known alignment windows.”
- Retries: “Some retries are not billed depending on request_outcome; dashboards that do not filter on outcome may overstate billed usage.”
- Credits: “Credits are applied at the invoice/account level; variant-level net revenue is approximate if accounts change variants within an invoice period.”

Appendix B — Questions to resolve
- Do we standardize assignment_unit as workspace_id across the board, or allow account_id for enterprise?
- Who owns experiment assignment: pricing service vs console vs billing? (Need one consistent emitter.)
- Do we need a dedicated “experiment_eligibility” table for reproducibility?

Changelog
- 2026-02-19: Added request_outcome/retry_reason requirements; added guardrail alert list aligned with ENG-4824; expanded credits attribution gap.
- 2026-02-03: Initial draft with dashboard pages + core metrics.
